meta.name: add-ollama-provider
meta.description: Route a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. Ollama speaks the Anthropic API natively (v1/messages), so no provider code changes are needed — just env var overrides and a model setting. Use when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. See docs/ollama.md for background.

copy.tagline: 把智能体切换到本地模型，减少接口调用成本。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想用本地模型运行 AI 助手，省下 API 调用费。
copy.tagline_en: Switch your AI assistant to a local model and save API costs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to run your AI assistant locally and cut API costs.

howto.what: 它把指定的 NanoClaw agent 组从 Anthropic 云端 API 切到本机运行的 Ollama 模型。做法是改配置里的环境变量和模型名，并重启服务，不改 provider 代码。
howto.when: 当你想让 agent 在本地运行、减少 API 花费，或试用开放权重模型时触发。前提是 Ollama 已装好并运行、已拉取模型，且该 agent 组已存在。

say.note: 会写入 env、设置 model 并重启服务

say.text: 列出本机 Ollama 已拉取的模型有哪些
say.note: 读取 localhost:11434 的模型列表

say.text: 把 agent 组 xxx 改回 Anthropic API

howto.what_en: It routes a chosen NanoClaw agent group from the Anthropic API to a locally running Ollama model. It does this by editing env vars and the model name in config, then restarting the service, with no provider code changes.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want an agent to run locally, cut API costs, or try open-weight models. Requires Ollama installed and running with a model pulled, and an existing agent group.

say_en.text: Switch agent group xxx to the local Ollama model gemma4
say_en.note: Writes env, sets model, restarts the service

say_en.text: List the models already pulled in my local Ollama
say_en.note: Reads the model list from localhost:11434

say_en.text: Switch agent group xxx back to the Anthropic API
say_en.note: Removes env, blockedHosts and model, then restarts
